_about: How customers in the United Kingdom pay, and what a small firm pays to take cards and how fast the money arrives, replacing the layout seed's payment mix (card 60, bank transfer 20, cash 12, digital wallet 8), its 1.5% card fee and its '1 to 3 days' payout, none of which was researched. all_payments and consumer_payments: the payments industry body's annual report summary for 2025, by number of payments; counts as printed (millions, or billions where the report prints billions) and shares only where the report prints them. The printed method counts sum to 49,773 million against the printed total of 49,712 million (CHAPS excluded), so no share is computed from the counts here. Mobile wallet payments are counted inside card payments; the report has no separate wallet share of payments. retail: the retail trade body's annual survey of its members' transactions for 2024. card_readers: each provider's own UK pages, read on the day checked; the three in-person fees match data/sections/local_apps.json (read 2025-09-25). Research: docs/superpowers/research/2026-10-04-uk-page-reform/R6-uk-facts-sourced.md.
